headline: Nevish Line Erupts Anew as Callahan's Passage Grinds On
war_summary: Since our last edition the storm has shifted its ground. Callahan's Passage remains the war's busiest field — seventy-nine actions in a day, forty-four of them at The Latch — though its hourly butcher's bill has slumped sharply from the late peak, and all ten posts remain in Colonial hands. The flare has passed to the Nevish Line, where losses are climbing hour by hour and the fighting about Princefal, Blackcoat Way and Grief Mother has produced fresh changes of flag; seven posts stand Warden to one Colonial. Stlican Shelf's seesaw goes on, the Wardens now holding three posts to six after Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost again drew the bulk of forty-three actions. The Weathered Expanse keeps its dreadful arithmetic at seven to two, the day's toll past twelve thousand on one side and eighteen on the other, though the pace eases from its peak. Stonecradle has kindled within the past two hours, one post left a ruin, and Linn Mercy has opened a hot account around Lathair. Fisherman's Row and Viper Pit, loud at our last writing, have gone quiet, and Mooring County's posts stand silent though its losses run deep. It is day 434 of the war; thirty-four victory towns will decide the issue, and no victor is named.
